name: graphql-core-operation-execution-v2
instr:
Restore the documented behavior of validated GraphQL operation execution — everything this repository does between accepting a validated operation together with its inputs and producing the result delivered to the caller. The governing authority is the scoped public documentation together with the public docstrings and behavioral comments in the scoped implementation. The implementation does not agree with that documentation in every respect. Find where it disagrees and make the code match what is documented, preserving all the other behavior those documents describe.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should not be rewritten to match whatever the implementation turns into afterwards. Once it is done, implement the plan.
